visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor restaurant setting. A young boy in a black jacket and striped shirt walks towards a woman seated at a wooden table. He holds a wine glass filled with red liquid. The woman, wearing a bright red turtleneck and gold earrings, rests her chin on her hands and smiles. (2) Close-up on the boy eating vanilla ice cream from a glass bowl. The woman suddenly interrupts him. She pulls out a black roll-up electronic piano from under her arm and lays it flat on the dining table. The boy looks confused and stops eating. (3) The boy begins pressing keys on the roll-up piano. The woman points at the keys, providing instruction with a stern yet amused expression. Several patrons are visible in the background seated at other tables. (4) Scene transitions to an indoor swimming pool or water park. The boy is shown swimming underwater and then climbing out of the pool wearing goggles and black swim trunks. (5) The woman, now in a black long-sleeved top and beige pants, is sitting on a stone ledge by the pool. She produces the roll-up piano again. The boy, still dripping wet, sits and plays the instrument. The woman claps her hands excitedly. (6) Scene transitions to a snowy outdoor ski resort. The boy, in full ski gear including a helmet and goggles, skis through colorful arches. (7) The woman in a white ski jacket approaches the boy on the snow. She unrolls the piano once more. The boy plays the keyboard in the middle of the ski slope. Numerous text bubbles and icons appear around him. (8) Final scene returns to the restaurant where the boy is drinking from the wine glass. A microphone and the piano are visible on the table.
